content:
Webb County recognized a group of county employees on Monday morning, November 9, 2026, for taking part in the county's Supervisory Academy.

The academy is offered by the Webb County Human Resources Department in partnership with Laredo College. It is designed to help participants strengthen their leadership and supervisory skills, better guide and support the employees they supervise, and build stronger communication and teamwork across county departments.

The county recognized the participants for completing the program and for the work they do leading teams that serve Webb County residents every day.

Source: Webb County, Texas, November 9, 2026.
